# `csharp_using_directive_placement`

Move using directives inside or outside the namespace. IDE0065.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `inside_namespace` |  |
| `outside_namespace` |  |

**Default:** `(as written)`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace N
{
    public class Widget { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N
{
    using System;
    using System.Collections.Generic;

    public class Widget { }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_using_directive_placement = inside_namespace`*

### `csharp_using_directive_placement = outside_namespace`

```ini
csharp_using_directive_placement = outside_namespace
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace N
{
    public class Widget { }
}
```
